name: EXM_CASH_ADVANCES
description: This table contains the details of the travel advances issued to employees, such as cash advance number, advance amount, status of the advance, amount applied to the expense report, and the cash advance balance.

columns.name: CASH_ADVANCE_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key that identifies a row in this table.

columns.name: SUBMITTER_ID
columns.description: Person who submits the cash advance.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRIP_ID
columns.description: Trip for which the cash advance was requested.

columns.name: CASH_ADVANCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Cash advance number is the document number used to identify a cash advance.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person requesting the cash advance.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment of the person requesting the cash advance.

columns.name: CASH_ADVANCE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of cash advance. Default value is 'TRAVEL'. References new lookup type EXM_CASH_ADVANCE_TYPE.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the cash advance.

columns.name: PURPOSE
columns.description: Purpose for requesting cash advance.

columns.name: TRIP_START_DATE
columns.description: Planned start date of trip if advance is requested for an upcoming trip.

columns.name: TRIP_END_DATE
columns.description: Planned end date of trip if advance is requested for an upcoming trip.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Cash advance amount.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for cash amount.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount paid to employee.

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the amount paid to employee.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate used for payment to employee.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type used for payment to employee.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_DATE
columns.description: Date when cash advance was submitted.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount specified by an auditor during audit.

columns.name: UNAPPLIED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Outstanding balance in payment currency that remains to be applied towards expense reports.

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date by which the cash advance should be applied towards an expense report.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the cash advance. References lookup type EXM_CASH_ADVANCE_STATUS.

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Payment method for the cash advance

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: EXPORT_REJECT_CODE
columns.description: Rejection code from process reimbursement

columns.name: LAST_AUDITED_BY
columns.description: Auditor who last audited the cash advance.

columns.name: AUDIT_RETURN_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for auditor to reject the cash advance request.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: APPROVAL_CORRELATION_ID
columns.description: Correlation ID to track approval process related to the cash advance.

columns.name: OVERDUE_CORRELATION_ID
columns.description: Correlation ID to track overdue process related to the cash advance.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: Location of the upcoming trip.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
